name: Mura Runetotem
summary: You carry a snapjaw shell from the Barrens across the sea to Mura Runetotem in Silverpine Forest. Its strange vitality may help the tauren healer aid the Forsaken.

sections.title: A Bridge Across Seas
sections.body: Tonga Runetotem notices something peculiar about altered snapjaws while investigating the magically changed wildlife around the Barrens oases. Their shells pulse with resilient energy despite their corruption. He asks you to carry one across the Great Sea to his clanmate, Mura Runetotem, who is stationed in the Eastern Kingdoms.

sections.title: Aiding the Forsaken
sections.body: Mura Runetotem is at the Sepulcher, a Forsaken outpost in Silverpine Forest. She made the arduous journey there to help the Horde's newest allies cleanse and renew their ailing, blighted woodland. Mura hopes the shell's inner glow and enduring spark of life will reveal ways to restore vitality to the northern continent.

faq.answer: Mura Runetotem is a tauren druid and Tonga Runetotem's clanmate. She traveled across the sea and established herself at the Sepulcher to aid the Forsaken by studying ways to heal their dying forest.
Mura Runetotem is at the Sepulcher, a Forsaken town along the road in central Silverpine Forest, in the Eastern Kingdoms.

faq.q: Why does Tonga want a snapjaw shell sent to Silverpine?
faq.answer: Altered snapjaw shells near the Barrens oases show unnatural vitality and an inner glow. Tonga believes studying that resilient life force may give Mura insights into healing Silverpine Forest's blighted, dying ecology.

faq.q: Why are the tauren trying to heal Forsaken lands?
faq.answer: Tauren hold a sacred duty to nurture and mend the natural world. Mura sees that Silverpine Forest is decaying and blighted, and hopes to use the earth's healing traditions to aid the Horde's new allies and restore balance to the soil.

faq.q: How does this quest connect the Barrens to Silverpine?
faq.answer: The shell's journey connects early Horde territories, carrying you from Kalimdor's plains to the forests of the Eastern Kingdoms.

faq.q: What happens after giving Mura the shell?
faq.answer: Mura is fascinated by the shell's lingering inner glow and resolves to study it closely as she seeks a remedy for Silverpine's blighted woodlands.

angles.text: As a tauren, you see the Runetotem clan's dedication to nurturing the natural world reach across the sea to Silverpine's withered groves.
As an undead, you may see the forest around the Sepulcher as lost to rot and blight, but tauren druids such as Mura Runetotem seek to renew it.
As a druid, you study unusual returns of nature, even those born of strange mutations, to help restore balance to broken lands.
As a member of the Horde, you see its growing bond in the cooperation between Kalimdor's defenders and the Forsaken in Lordaeron.
